text:
alex: Heads-up — I prototyped an auth+route header negotiation to avoid breaking older SDKs. Proposal: add a small `x-rd-features` negotiation header and have servers accept both old and new auth headers during migration. Example:

```
  x-rd-features: auth=v2;route=v1
```

priya: Nice. main concern: Python SDK still reads API key from env var. We shouldn't force everyone to change. Can server fallback to `x-api-key`/query param when `x-rd-token` is missing?

sam: Server-side shim for ~6 months sounds fine. We just need clear telemetry so we can tell which clients are still using legacy. Suggest adding `x-rd-client-version` or emit an `auth_migration` tag.

marco: Watch out for quotas — quota buckets currently keyed by auth identity. Changing header semantics will fragment existing quota mappings. Migration plan should include mapping old->new buckets or a `quota_migration` metric.

alex: Proposal update: servers accept both headers. Priority: if `x-rd-token` present, treat as new identity; otherwise fallback to legacy key. Emit telemetry tag `auth_migration=legacy|new` on every request and a counter `rd.quota.migration.mapped` / `rd.quota.migration.unmapped`. Also add a Console toggle (feature flag: `accept_legacy_auth_headers`) so orgs can opt out.

nina: For SDK shims: keep them non-breaking — add new header when token exists, otherwise keep current behavior. Add a deprecation warning that logs once per process if env var is used, so customers see it but nothing explodes. We'll only bump major if we plan to remove legacy flow later.

priya: +1. Also add e2e canary runs against Dedicated customers and surface a dashboard tile that shows `auth_migration` distribution and sample traces for troubleshooting.

devex-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/542 — server shim + initial telemetry and metrics export.

sam: LGTM. One more security note: new token format includes `kid` and HMAC differences. Eng-security should verify both validation paths behave identically. I'll file an audit ticket.

alex: Good call. I'll draft a rollout runbook: 1) server shim + telemetry, 2) SDK patches (py/ts/go) as non-breaking minor releases, 3) Console toggle + dashboard, 4) canary on Dedicated, 5) monitor metrics for 6 months then propose removal.

priya: Maybe also include a small migration guide for customers with self-hosted proxies (examples + curl snippet). Quick fallback snippet for servers: `if headers.get("x-rd-token"): use_new() else: use_legacy()` — keep it tiny.

marco: I'll write the quota mapping RFC and include the metric names/labels so billing can backfill.

alex: Perfect. I'll post the runbook + link to the PR in #eng-platform once it's ready. Thanks all :raised_hands:
